en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small railway station or house-like station building in front of a forested hill or mountain. A short train with freight or passenger cars stands on the tracks beside the building. Evergreen trees line the base of the mountain behind. The caption "TABERG." is printed at the bottom left of the image, and there is handwritten cursive text in a Scandinavian language along the right margin and at the top edge.
